summary_bullets: Add a Bash 3.2-safe retry helper for empty or UNKNOWN mergeStateStatus reads
Retry the initial merge-state read 4 times and route recovered BEHIND through main_advanced with empty ERROR
Extend merge-pr docs and offline harness coverage for persistent and transient initial UNKNOWN states
commit_message:
Fix initial mergeStateStatus UNKNOWN retry

Add a shared retry helper for empty/UNKNOWN PR metadata reads, apply it to the initial merge-state check with four retries, and preserve the existing post-force-push retry/error contract. Extend merge-pr tests and sibling docs for persistent empty/UNKNOWN, UNKNOWN-to-CLEAN, and UNKNOWN-to-BEHIND initial recovery cases.
